consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment
controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels
integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: uncontrolled movement of LA-7202 during transfer operations

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the secondary containment by bund and drainage on LA-7202 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in managing hydrocarbon transfer and storage, specifically bunding, drainage and spill containment. LA-7202 (marine loading arms) is in service for ship loading. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was never verified as effective. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 11 June 2024 an incident occurred on LA-7202 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during transfer operations, releasing chemical energy held as hydrocarbon.
